dealbreakers: Claims about ShareLove Letters that its own pricing page contradicts. https://www.shareloveletters.com/pricing, read today on 20 Nov 2026 with the DataForSEO page reader, lists a Free plan (ad-supported, 1 photo, no voice), a Single Letter Keepsake at $3.99 once (up to 3 photos, a voice memo, no ads, the link never expires) and ShareLove VIP at $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year (5 photos, voice notes, every link kept for life). The post says its price is just "Free.", says the number of photos and voice are "not stated", and says only three of the eleven sites offer voice. In Spanish the free account "te avisa" (notifies you), but its email alerts are VIP only.
A false internal-link claim: the post says /blog/digital-gift-websites-compared covers "eight sites" (Spanish: "ocho"), but that post compares nine ("We make Ethos, one of the nine sites below").
